milestones.name: Mantis Claw acquired
milestones.note: Found near the bottom of Fungal Wastes in Mantis Village after flipping a lever

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Glowing teal/blue bioluminescent mushrooms and floating spores, dark cavern atmosphere

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Sub-area at the bottom of Fungal Wastes, populated by Mantis and Mantis Youths
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark silhouette architecture with glowing orbs, mantis enemy silhouettes on tall poles

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Requires Mothwing Cloak (referred to as muffling cloak in transcript) to access. Located behind a lever puzzle guarded by Mantis and Mantis Youths.

bosses.name: Mantis Youth
bosses.note: Two Mantis Youths guard the room containing Mantis Claw

bosses.name: Mantis
bosses.note: Mantis enemies guard the lever required to access the Mantis Claw room

objectives.name: Flip the lever in Mantis Village
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat or bypass Mantis and Mantis Youths guarding the lever in the lower section of the room

objectives.name: Reach the top path after lever flip
objectives.hopDescription: Return to the beginning of the room and take the upper route opened by the lever

objectives.name: Defeat two Mantis Youths guarding Mantis Claw
objectives.hopDescription: Clear the final room at the end of the upper path to collect Mantis Claw

connectors.description: Mantis Village is located near the bottom of Fungal Wastes, accessible through corridors patrolled by Mantis enemies
